knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Suspected mould is outside routine cleaning.
Excess moisture can remain in the core.
Full drying is required before use.

practicalCriteria: Records the condition of a sample mattress before work, including odour and dampness.
Tests a product on an inconspicuous area and avoids over-wetting.
Refers a simulated suspected mould patch and does not treat it as routine.
passRule: Condition recorded, test done, moisture controlled, and suspected mould referred. Observed in a supervised simulation.
stopWorkCriteria: Mattress returned to use while damp
